name: Modify Firmware
summary: Firmware is low-level software embedded in hardware that enables systems and devices to function properly and is commonly found in ICS environments. Adversaries may modify firmware on a system or device by installing malicious or vulnerable versions that enable them to achieve objectives such as Persistence, Impair Process Control, and Inhibit Response Function. Adversaries may modify system and device firmware by using the built-in firmware…

analytics.name: Analytic 2047
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies the full firmware modification chain: a device entering firmware-update mode, receiving a large data transfer on a firmware-capable protocol port from a source not in the approved engineering workstation list, rebooting, and reporting a post-reboot firmware hash that does not match the authorized inventory. This technique-level analytic synthesizes System Firmware (T1693.001) and Module Firmware (T1693.002). OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control…
